findings.description: Detector signature {transcriptPath, asOf} cannot do the manifest.sessionId fallback. Thread sessionId into the codex detector call (data.session_id || manifest.sessionId).
findings.resolution: ADOPTED. stop.js now resolves transcriptPath via data.transcript_path || manifest.transcriptPath || resolveCodexTranscriptPath(sessionId); sessionId = data.session_id || manifest.sessionId. Detector stays pure on {transcriptPath, asOf}.

findings.description: Proposed sample shape {sessionId,cmd,isListener} is not parity with the Copilot detector's {shellId,toolName,command,isListener}.
findings.resolution: ADOPTED. samples use { shellId: String(sessionId), toolName: 'exec_command', command: cmd, isListener }.

findings.description: Terminal-detection 'unknown-process/failure text' is unenumerated; risks false-ALLOW on dead sessions.
findings.resolution: ADOPTED (structural rule). An await output for session N marks N TERMINAL iff the output does NOT contain 'Process running with session ID N'; an await output that DOES contain it REFRESHES the running marker at the current row. No enumeration needed; covers exit/unknown/failure/timeout uniformly.

findings.section: Approach > Detector algorithm step 5b; Acceptance Criteria #3/#5
findings.description: Current-turn freshness appears to contradict the structural-completeness argument (a prior-turn still-running session would be false-blocked).
findings.resolution: CLARIFIED-AND-DEFENDED (deliberate false-negative bias from the brainstorm; do NOT weaken). A session stays 'fresh' if re-asserted this turn by EITHER an exec_command launch OR an await_background_completion that returns 'still running' (re-stamps the marker in the current turn). The legitimate codex bg-polling idiom IS to await (which blocks the turn, or returns still-running and refreshens); a prior-turn session never re-touched is the stall to block (recoverable). AC #3/#5 reworded accordingly.

findings.description: Mixed 'unreadable -> block' vs 'null -> skip' policy; needs one explicit contract for missing/unreadable/empty/malformed/fallback-miss.
findings.resolution: ADOPTED. null transcriptPath (incl. fallback miss) -> gate SKIPPED (existing if(transcriptPath) guard; failure-open). Non-null but unreadable/empty/all-malformed -> detector returns empty result -> effectiveActive 0 -> BLOCK (matches Copilot detector; recoverable). Detector THROW -> stop.js try/catch -> detection=null -> gate skipped.
REJECTED as stated (OR is commutative; the two are logically identical). Adopted the (isCodex || !isRetry) wording for clarity + a code comment. Downgraded to Low.

findings.resolution: ADOPTED. Rephrased to: existing Copilot progress-bg-gate tests stay green; Copilot log line stays engine=copilot; Claude remains skipped; no codex detector import path is exercised for engine==='copilot'.

findings.description: Clarify whether codex subagent (task/multi_agent) invocations produce exec_command sessions that the detector would count.
findings.resolution: CLARIFIED. The detector recognizes ONLY unified-exec sessions ('Process running with session ID N'); codex subagent spawns are a different tool surface that does not emit that marker, so they are neither counted nor false-allowed. Documented in Out of Scope.

findings.resolution: Folded into F-010: US-005 marked LEAD-coordinated post-merge acceptance.

findings.description: Unclear whether current-turn scoping applies to terminal detection (step 4) or only to RUNNING freshness (step 5b); awaitArgs indexing scope ambiguous.
findings.resolution: CLARIFIED via a single ordered walk maintaining sessionState[N]={lastSignal,lastRowIndex,cmd}; active iff lastSignal==='running' && lastRowIndex>boundary && cmd non-infra. Pre-boundary awaits naturally mark terminal.
